'''Vendri DeRalm''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Holographer/Legends|holographer]] who was subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was recruited into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by "[[Mother (Rebel)|Mother]]" and shortly afterward participated in the [[Takeover at Whisper Base|Takeover]] at [[Whisper Base]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vendri DeRalm appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
